title: Factory preset content refinement
description:
Refine factory preset JSON content under Resources/Presets/ so shipping presets match CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §24 intent: gain-conscious, category-correct, profile-aligned, and usable starting points (not extreme mute or extreme boost).

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §24 Factory Presets and primary macro parameters (§25 ranges)
- Existing Resources/Presets/*.json from phase J (j.3)
- Source/ParameterIDs.h for stable parameter id strings (read-only)
- Source/Profiles.h profile names/indices (read-only)
- Source/StateManager factory preset loader expectations (read-only)

Refine (create if missing) these six categorized factory presets:
- Resources/Presets/Rhythm_ModernTight.json — tight rhythm / palm-mute; deep floor; strong attack guard; Tight Rhythm profile
- Resources/Presets/Lead_SingingSustain.json — lead sustain / soft floor; adaptive releaseheading; Lead Sustain profile
- Resources/Presets/PostAmp_HissSuppression.json — post-amp hiss; Hiss Curtain friendly; Post-Amp Hiss profile
- Resources/Presets/DIKeyed_Rhythm.json — external key, alignment- and lookahead-conscious defaults; DI-Keyed Reamp profile
- Resources/Presets/Bass_ActiveNoiseControl.json — active bass hum rejection; moderate sustain; Active Bass profile
- Resources/Presets/Diag_LearnMyRig.json — diagnostic / Noise Learn starting point; safe defaults, not extreme mute

Refinement rules:
- Keep consistent JSON shape: meta (name, category, description, schema_version, profileId/profileName, optional tuningId) + parameters map keyed by ParameterIDs
- Gain-conscious: outputTrim near 0 dB; no extreme output boosts
- Thresholds, floors, tightness, sustain, hiss macros intentional per category
- Valid UTF-8 JSON
- Do not edit C++ sources, CMake, scripts, or docs in this task

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: Resources/Presets/Rhythm_ModernTight.json exists and is valid JSON
Resources/Presets/DIKeyed_Rhythm.json exists and is valid JSON
Resources/Presets/Diag_LearnMyRig.json exists and is valid JSON
Each preset includes meta name/category/schema_version and a parameters map keyed by parameter IDs
Each preset references a profile id or name aligned with its category intent
Presets remain gain-conscious (no extreme outputTrim boosts) and category-appropriate
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: embed binary blobs or non-JSON formats

allowed: adjust numeric parameter values within named category intent
preserve or lightly extend the shared meta+parameters JSON shape
align profileId/profileName with existing profile names from Profiles.h
forbidden: add new preset categories beyond the six listed files
